roomEvents.title: An inscription on a fallen pillar.
roomEvents.description: The script flickers as if alive. Untranslated, it watches you.

onPass.narration: The pillar dissolves, revealing a vault. Gold and a glimmer of insight.

onFail.narration: The script burns your eyes; you stagger back.

onPass.narration: Sacred light scatters the malice. The pillar yields its secrets.

onFail.narration: No one in the party can call upon the divine here.

roomEvents.title: A pressure plate clicks beneath your boot.
roomEvents.description: Dim torchlight glints off a wire. One wrong move and the ceiling comes down.

onPass.narration: The plate clicks back into place. You pocket a small ruby left as bait.

onFail.narration: A spike-trap fires before you can move. The party takes a hit.

onPass.narration: You jam the plate with a wedge. The trap stays mute.

onFail.narration: Your wedge snaps. The trap fires anyway.

onPass.narration: Whatever's behind the trap will stay there.
